artworks.title: Eve Repentant
artworks.dimensions:
image:  330 x 475 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:   456 x 603 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a nude person seated on the ground with their knees to their chest, arms around their legs, and head resting on their knees. They have long, wavy hair, subtle facial features, and are positioned against a textured vertical surface resembling a tree trunk with foliage overhead. An apple lies near their feet, and they hold another apple in one hand. The background consists of detailed leaves and branches in a shaded area, suggesting an outdoor setting. In the lower right corner, there is a small sketch of two birds near foliage.

artworks.title: Dark Single Hollyhocks
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of large hollyhock flowers in monochrome colors. The flowers are central with buds and stems around them. The artist's signature is at the bottom right.

artworks.title: A Lesson in Wisdom
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  253 x 374 mm
sheet:  335 x 483 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features flowing lines and sharp angles, with a seated figure and rounded shapes placed along a horizontal plane. The composition includes intricate cross-hatching and sweeping curves, suggesting a landscape intertwined with man-made structures. The figure appears to be a woman in a draped gown leaning forward gracefully. Next to her are small, rounded forms with circular eyes resembling owls. These elements are joined by abstract foliage and linear details creating a dreamlike scene.

artworks.title: A Wet Evening in Venice
artworks.dimensions:
image: 130 x 319 mm
sheet:  184 x 354 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene depicted from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is low, with ships and their masts visible. The brushstrokes are distinct, applied with a crosshatching technique for movement and texture. The color palette is mainly sepia and dark brown. A rowing boat with a figure is depicted on the right, with buildings and ship masts in the distance, reflected in the water.

artworks.title: Horizontorium
artworks.dimensions:
image: 511 x 352 mm
sheet:  519 x 387 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is an architectural drawing of a building named "HORIZONTORIUM." The structure features a complex facade with tall chimney-like structures on the roof, framed by decorative fencing. The building is situated at a street corner and has a design that combines classical and Gothic elements, including arched windows and crenelated parapets. The surrounding area includes lush greenery, pathways with cobblestones and stepping stones, and figures walking or standing nearby. The drawing blends detailed architectural features with natural elements, creating a rich and intricate depiction of the building.

artworks.title: Untitled (Boys Flying a Kite)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 257 x 192 mm
plate:   292 x 221 mm
sheet: 436 x 349 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with two young figures relaxing on a grassy area. One person is sitting with an arm raised, while the other is lying down with legs extended and hands behind their head. In the background, there are distant trees. The artwork features detailed lines creating texture in the landscape, clothing, and expressions of the figures. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white tones. Faint figures, likely animals, are visible in the background against a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Cascades at Tivoli
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is an engraved landscape of a rocky cliff with waterfalls cascading down. The perspective is from below looking up at the cliff with the waterfalls. A building, possibly a temple, is visible on the top of the cliff. The engraving uses detailed lines, cross-hatching for depth, texture, and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using gray tones to depict light and shadow. Foliage and rocks surround the waterfalls, leading the eye up to the structure above.

artworks.title: Untitled (Log Raft Fishing)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 189 x 557 mm (not including remarque)
primary sheet: 252 x 616 mm
secondary sheet: 352 x 698 mm (irregular)
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a serene scene of two figures fishing on a log raft. Closest to us, a large fish is caught on a fishing line causing ripples in the water. Beyond the raft, there are rocky islands adorned with evergreens. The horizon meets distant, gently undulating hills. The background is filled with light, sketch-like strokes and the color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and subtle lines.

artworks.title: Village Street in France With a Flock of Sheep
artworks.dimensions:
image: 192 x 242 mm
plate:   232 x 276 mm
sheet: 348 x 425 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with a flock of sheep being herded along a dirt path. The horizon is low, emphasizing the sky above. In the distance, there are trees and foliage. The artwork features detailed brushstrokes, typical of etching, showcasing textures of vegetation and sheep wool. The color palette is monochrome with shades of gray and black. To the left, there is a thatched structure partially hidden by trees, while on the right, a shepherd and a dog are guiding the sheep.

artworks.title: Untitled (Garden)
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 308 x 445 mm
Sheet: 380 x 518 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene at a carnival or fairground. The piece depicts a bustling atmosphere filled with activity and entertainment. Various signs and text such as "GARDEN" and "HOT DOGS" are visible. A tall building with intricate details is illuminated in the background. The scene includes a carousel with ornate horses on the right side and a ferris wheel. Brightly lit displays and signage contribute to the dynamic energy of the fair, combined with architectural features that evoke a sense of nostalgia and celebration.

artworks.title: Untitled (Wooded Landscape)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 137 x 175 mm
sheet:  229 x 309 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a forest of gnarled and twisted trees. The trees dominate the scene with their sinuous forms and rugged textures. The horizon is not visible, as the trees fill the composition from the foreground to the depths of the wooded area. The style features etching techniques, with fine lines and dark, shadowy areas enhancing the textures of the bark and branches. The color palette is primarily sepia, giving an antique look and allowing the contours and shadows to stand out vividly.

artworks.title: Untitled (Wooded Landscape)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 137 x 175 mm
sheet:  224 x 314 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts twisting trees dominating the scene. The horizon is low in the composition, where the tree trunks meet the ground. The brushstrokes emphasize the texture of the tree bark and branches. The color palette consists of muted browns and grays with hints of color suggesting light or lichen on the trunks. More trees are visible in the background, adding depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Pacific Coast, California
artworks.dimensions:
image: 120 x 168 mm
sheet:  222 x 357 mm
plate:   127 x 176 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a landscape scene with a rugged coastline viewed from a high vantage point. The horizon is set slightly above the center, with the ocean meeting the sky. A sun is visible on the horizon, radiating beams across the sky and reflecting on the water below. The sky has stylized clouds defined by intricate line work. The brushstrokes create a crosshatch style, adding texture to the rocks and fluidity to the water and sky. The rocky cliffs are detailed with dark lines, standing out against the lighter tones of the water and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones, adding drama to the coastal landscape.

artworks.title: The Cherry Blossoms - High Tea
artworks.dimensions:
image: 196 x 120 mm
sheet:  280 x 227 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows large butterflies on and around clusters of cherry blossoms in grayscale. The butterflies are positioned among the blossoms that flow diagonally from the bottom left corner to the upper right corner, with one butterfly placed slightly separate towards the top left. The blossoms and foliage create a natural border where the butterflies seem to interact.

artworks.title: Iris
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seated figure with one leg bent and their body slightly turned to the side. The person's facial features, long hair, and unclothed body are depicted with shading to suggest depth and form. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background consists of abstract patterns and blotches in varying shades, creating a textured setting. The overall tones are muted and monochrome.

artworks.title: Bugle Call
artworks.dimensions:
image: 450 x 348 mm
sheet:  545 x 395 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an individual playing a bugle while seated on a rearing horse. The person is wearing a military uniform and holding the reins with one hand.

artworks.title: Going Into Camp at Night
artworks.dimensions:
image: 276 x 394 mm
primary sheet: 310 x 434 mm
secondary sheet: 462 x 573 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a wide-angle view of a military scene. A soldier's encampment is in the foreground, with figures near a campfire on the left, and marching soldiers with rifles and a horse-drawn cart on the right. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking across a vast encampment with tents, soldiers, and smoke. The horizon cuts across the upper third of the image. The style is highly detailed and illustrative, focusing on texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray and dark tones to create contrast and depth.

artworks.title: The Advance of the Cavalry
artworks.dimensions:
image: 279 x 396 mm
primary sheet: 318 x 432 mm
secondary sheet: 468 x 580 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mounted soldier holding a rifle. The soldier is on a horse, gripping a rifle, with a cavalry unit advancing in the background. A small building is visible in the distance, in an open field bordered by trees. The lighting and shading create a realistic effect, capturing the movement of the rider and the horse. Attention to detail is shown in the texture of the horse's mane and the soldier's attire. The wide horizon emphasizes the military setting.

artworks.title: Neapolitan Fishing Boats Returning Home
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a sailboat navigating choppy waters. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, revealing the tops of the waves and the motion of the sea. The horizon is low with a setting sun casting a soft glow on the water. The brushstrokes are defined and expressive, capturing the sea's movement and texture. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by shades of brown and beige. The sailboat is tilted by the wind, with figures on the deck. Two smaller sailboats are in the distance to the right. The sky above has light cloud-like streaks.

artworks.title: Moonlight N.Y.
artworks.dimensions:
Image: 198 x 146 mm
Sheet: 290 x 200 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a city landscape from ground level. Buildings block the horizon, with tall buildings in the distance partially covered in mist. The scene has a soft focus and hazy effect due to blended brushstrokes. The color palette is muted with tones of gray and black. Two figures are seen interacting under a tree with urban structures in the background.

artworks.title: Untitled (Summer)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 504 x 278 mm (not including remarque)
sheet:  621 x 381 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a waterside scene with calm waters, trees lining the horizon, foliage, reeds, lily pads, tall grasses, and a cloudy sky with a warm sepia color palette.

artworks.title: Untitled (Winter Landscape)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 501 x 278 mm
sheet:  620 x 380 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a snowy path flanked by tall trees with bare branches. In the distance, there are buildings surrounded by more trees. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing textures and footprints in the snow. The scene has a monochromatic color palette of black and white. A person with a hat and an axe is walking on the path towards the buildings.

artworks.title: Dance of Centaurs
artworks.medium: aquatint and softground in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate:  326 x 231 mm
sheet:  379 x 276 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological beings in a rocky landscape with waterfalls. The drawing depicts an array of figures in a flowing water scene comprising waterfalls, streams, and swirls. Figures include some resembling centaurs and others appearing as human-like figures amidst the landscape elements. Various poses suggest movement and interaction. Water cascades down rocks in the background, while figures are depicted in the foreground. Light, shadow, and fluid lines enhance the mythical and energetic quality of the scene.

artworks.title: Excursion Boat
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people inside a vehicle or room. It includes a violinist and an observer smoking a pipe. The scene captures the vibrant energy of a group setting where the violinist is playing with enthusiasm, drawing attention from the surrounding individuals. The violinist is near a large wooden structure, potentially a door or partition, interacting with another person whose hand is reaching out. In the background, there is an ornately patterned railing suggesting an enclosed or intimate space. One individual is holding a pipe while enveloped in smoke, absorbed in the moment. The various textures and lines evoke movement and engagement among the spectators and performers.
